headline: A 2003 executive order protects the Development Fund for Iraq and certain other property in which Iraq has an interest.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up legal protections for the Development Fund for Iraq and some other property tied to Iraq. No official summary was provided, so the exact protections, and which property they cover, are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: The government of Iraq and the Development Fund for Iraq
who_it_affects.how: The fund and certain Iraqi-linked property receive protection under US law, according to the title.

who_it_affects.group: People or companies with legal claims against Iraq
who_it_affects.how: They may face limits on reaching the protected fund or property, though the title alone does not say how.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 22, 2003; no separate start date is given in the material provided.
